name: Hardened Foes
description: Enemy ships take {value}% less damage to shields, armor and hull.
flavor: Someone has been selling the good plating to the wrong people.

name: Brittle Foes
description: Enemy ships take {value}% more damage to shields, armor and hull.
flavor: Cheap welds, tired crews, and nobody left to fix either.

name: Deadly Foes
description: Enemy weapons deal {value}% more damage.
flavor: Every raider in the Sector seems to have found a better gunnery manual.

name: Dull Blades
description: Enemy weapons deal {value}% less damage.
flavor: Their shells were bought from the lowest bidder.

name: Plated Foes
description: Enemy ships have {value}% more armor.
flavor: Extra plates bolted on wherever a plate will fit.

name: Rusted Foes
description: Enemy ships have {value}% less armor.
flavor: Their hulls have not seen a drydock since the Collapse.

name: Hasty Foes
description: Enemy ships and fighters are {value}% faster in combat.
flavor: They burn their engines hot and do not care what it costs.

name: Sluggish Foes
description: Enemy ships and fighters are {value}% slower in combat.
flavor: Clogged injectors and bad fuel slow every hunter down.

name: Long Guns
description: Enemy ballistic and energy weapons reach {value}% farther.
flavor: Their targeting suites came from somewhere they should not have.

name: Short Sights
description: Enemy ballistic and energy weapons reach {value}% shorter.
flavor: Half their sensor arrays are held together with tape.

name: Swift Pursuers
description: Hostile fleets gain {value} maximum burn level.
flavor: Hunters always seem to know the shortest way to you.

name: Lumbering Hunters
description: Hostile fleets lose {value} maximum burn level.
flavor: Overloaded holds, worn drives, and no patience to fix them.

name: Worn Barrels
description: Your weapons deal {value}% less damage.
flavor: Every barrel in your fleet is two refits past its service life.

name: Sharp Gunnery
description: Your weapons deal {value}% more damage.
flavor: Gun crews who drill until they hit in their sleep.

name: Thin Plating
description: Your ships have {value}% less armor.
flavor: The yard swore those plates were full thickness.

name: Reinforced Plating
description: Your ships have {value}% more armor.
flavor: Another layer of plate, and then one more for luck.

name: Clogged Engines
description: Your ships are {value}% slower in combat.
flavor: Something is living in the fuel lines. Nobody wants to look.

name: Tuned Engines
description: Your ships are {value}% faster in combat.
flavor: Your engineers tune the drives between every jump.

name: Short Reach
description: Your ballistic and energy weapons reach {value}% shorter.
flavor: Your fire control computers keep losing count.

name: Long Reach
description: Your ballistic and energy weapons reach {value}% farther.
flavor: Fire control salvaged from a Domain survey ship.

name: Thin Insulation
description: Your ships and your allies' ships stay overloaded {value}% longer.
flavor: Cheap flux conduits, cheaper insulation.

name: Grounded Conduits
description: Overloads on your ships and your allies' ships end {value}% sooner.
flavor: Every conduit grounded twice and checked three times.

name: Green Crews
description: Your ships have {value}% less maximum combat readiness.
flavor: Fresh from the recruiting office and still learning which end fires.

name: Veteran Crews
description: Your ships have {value}% more maximum combat readiness.
flavor: Old hands who have seen worse than this.

name: Hungry Fleet
description: Your ships use {value}% more supplies each month.
flavor: Spare parts vanish, and nobody saw a thing.

name: Lean Logistics
description: Your ships use {value}% fewer supplies each month.
flavor: A quartermaster who counts every bolt twice.

name: Heavy Drives
description: Your ships lose {value} maximum burn level.
flavor: The drive field drags like the ship is towing a moon.

name: Hyperspace Drifter
description: Your ships gain {value} maximum burn level.
flavor: Ride the currents, never against them.

name: Clumsy Shipwrights
description: Your ships can take {value} fewer built-in hull mods.
flavor: Your yards weld the wrong parts to the wrong hulls.

name: Master Shipwrights
description: Your ships can take {value} more built-in hull mods.
flavor: Shipwrights who learned their trade on Domain hulls.

name: Harsh Worlds
description: Your colonies have {value}% more hazard rating.
flavor: The worlds remember the Domain's mistakes, and they make settlers pay for them.

name: Gentle Worlds
description: Your colonies have {value}% less hazard rating.
flavor: Some worlds still remember the gardens they were meant to be.

name: Ludd's Song
description: Gate travel costs no fuel.
flavor: The gates sing for those who woke them.
unlockHint: Finish At the Gates to unlock.

name: Peerless
description: Grants {value} Peerless point, once per campaign.
flavor: Some captains are simply better than the rest.
